R245.note: Parameterized SqlCommand with named params closes the injection; returns int row count as before, no scope change.

R246.note: Adds the missing can:update,order authorization to the purge route, matching the pattern already used on sibling mutating routes.

R247.note: fsockopen eliminates the shell entirely, but the write-up openly swaps ICMP-ping semantics for a TCP-port-80 check and adds a hostname allowlist, either of which can reject/mischaracterize previously-reachable hosts.

R248.note: Verified empirically that JexlSandbox(false)+newInstance(false) correctly denies method/constructor access by default and blocks the RCE payloads while leaving the intended amount/region/owner comparisons working; but the added character-allowlist regex omits +, *, /, % so it would reject legitimate arithmetic filter expressions, disclosed only as defense-in-depth.

R249.note: Adds @PreAuthorize to the entry point, closing the proxy self-invocation bypass consistent with the existing deleteInvoice check.

R250.note: basename rejection plus realpath containment check closes traversal without narrowing the documented single-filename use case.

R251.note: Same verified sandbox mechanism as R248 correctly blocks RCE; allowlist regex omits '.' so decimal literals in rule text would be rejected, an unstated-as-required restriction disclosed only as defense-in-depth.

R252.note: Converts the state-changing action from GET to POST with ValidateAntiForgeryToken, the standard and disclosed CWE-352 remediation for this sink.

R253.note: Path.resolve(strict=True) plus is_relative_to correctly follows symlinks and validates containment; controller's leaf-filename behavior and fail-closed semantics for missing/escaping paths are preserved per the stated contract.

R254.note: Verified by running against Sequelize/sqlite: ':startDate'/':endDate' placeholders are the 'replacements' syntax, not valid for the 'bind' option (which needs $startDate), so the query throws SQLITE_RANGE on every call and the endpoint is broken for all legitimate requests; write-up incorrectly claims behavior is preserved.

R255.note: Standard overflow-before-multiply check plus null-input guard; frees batch on every early-return path, matching the stated contract.

R256.note: filepath.Rel + '..' prefix check correctly blocks traversal after Join; Go's Join does not have the absolute-path-overrides-base gotcha, so this is safe.

R257.note: Replaces extension-based probeContentType with Tika magic-byte detection against the same allowlist, closing the type-spoofing gap without changing accepted types.

R258.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner in validated_data (kwargs take precedence in DRF's save()), correctly server-enforcing ownership on create.

R259.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare requires exact, equal-length match and preserves the empty-string short-circuit, matching the stated contract exactly.
